tagline: Design trusted agent orders with explicit buyer authority.
introduction: Design the fixed-price product lookup, inquiry and order/approval interface for Valio Aimo synthetic mock systems. Bind decisions to the buyer request and exact basket; test partial stock, substitutions and delivery constraints. Do not treat a recipe plan as a placed order.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Valio Aimo? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.description: Explain scaling arithmetic; the offline fictional recipe helper preserves unit, source and allergen unknowns without product or safety claims.

capabilities.title: Check a product information gap
capabilities.description: Identify missing product facts before a foodservice decision.
